name: @senon/webmcp-sdk-docs
description: Documentation site for @senon/webmcp-sdk (Fumadocs on TanStack Start, fully static). Not published.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-api.mjs && vite build && node scripts/finalize-out.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:snippets && pnpm build && pnpm check:routes && pnpm check:links
scripts.check:routes: git diff --exit-code -- src/routeTree.gen.ts || (echo "src/routeTree.gen.ts is stale: commit the version the build generated" && exit 1)
